hist_case.problem: The Taloa Overlay blueprint reached MANUFACTURING_AUTHORIZED and then sat unbuilt for two days. The authorization existed; no mission pack existed to execute it, so the factory had nothing to run.
hist_case.case_text: The prior failure was not a rejected build — it was an authorization with no executable artifact behind it. Phase 1 was scheduled across two factories in products/receipts/TWO_FACTORY_PLAN_RECEIPT.json, and the dependency cycle and store contracts were resolved internally per the Founder Escalation Threshold, but no BLUEPRINT.json under builderos-reboot/MISSIONS ever carried those 16 steps. This mission is the missing artifact.
ideas: Generate the mission pack mechanically from the sealed blueprint so no step is paraphrased by hand (scripts/generate-taloa-phase1-mission.mjs).
Five of seven store steps bind to existing canonical tables rather than creating new ones, per the Architect's reuse-first resolution in products/receipts/ARCHITECT_STORE_RESOLUTION_RECEIPT.json.
hist_case.opportunity: The sealed contracts in products/artifacts/OVERLAY_AMENDED_BLUEPRINT.json already carry factory_signature and test_assertions per step, so the authoring prompts and the behaviour assertions can both be derived from one frozen source instead of being invented at build time.

cfo_receipt.note: Founder-directed urgent build; authoring cost accrues per step under the standard tier ladder.
